ratios.facility: Credit Agreement dated as of May 15, 2025, as amended
ratios.quote: Ralliant must maintain a Consolidated Net Leverage Ratio, as defined by the Credit Agreement, of 3.50 to 1.00 or less

parsed.notes: Only the requirement is disclosed; the actual ratio is not stated, only that Ralliant was in compliance as of October 2, 2026. The maximum may step up to 4.00x for four quarters after a permitted acquisition of $100.0 million or more, at most twice after the Closing Date; the excerpt does not indicate that any step-up is in effect. The Second Amendment (March 30, 2026) removed the 85% cap on netting non-U.S. cash and cash equivalents when calculating the net leverage ratio.
